name: realtime-collaborative-whiteboard
title: Realtime Collaborative Whiteboard
description: A collaborative drawing whiteboard mockup showing active cursor presences, sticky note objects, and shape tools.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Canvas Collaboration Cursor Tracking: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
